fusions.name: Wary Distance
fusions.desc: Hits a target up to 7 tiles away: it deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Breaking Cover
fusions.desc: A burst that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 2.5 tiles. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Skittish Zigzag
fusions.desc: You spring 3 tiles aside, and your dodge chance rises by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Mend
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
